summary: Tested Portal Team Collaboration feature and Delete Deal bug fix. All backend endpoints exist and require authentication as expected. Code review verified: 1) PropertyIntelligencePanel.handleDelete uses fetch DELETE /api/deals/{deal_id} with auth token (lines 456-494), 2) PortalDetail.js has 3 tabs (Deals, Members, Team Access) with collaborator management, 3) Portals.js shows 'Shared' badge for is_collaborator portals, 4) Backend routes properly registered.

portal_collaborators_endpoints.details: All 3 endpoints exist and require auth: GET/POST /api/portals/{portal_id}/collaborators, DELETE /api/portals/{portal_id}/collaborators/{user_id}

delete_deal_bug_fix.details: handleDelete now uses fetch DELETE to ${API}/deals/${data.id} with Bearer token auth instead of direct Supabase client-side delete

portal_detail_tabs.details: 3 tabs implemented: 'deals', 'members', 'team' (Team Access). Tab buttons at lines 365-383 with data-testid='tab-{tab}'

team_access_tab.details: Team Access tab shows collaborators list with name, email, role. Invite Team Member button (data-testid='invite-team-btn') opens dialog. Remove collaborator button (data-testid='remove-collaborator-{user_id}')

portals_shared_badge.details: Shows 'Shared' badge when portal.is_collaborator is true

portals_list_includes_collaborator_porta.details: GET /api/portals now fetches portal_collaborators for user and includes shared portals with is_collaborator=True flag

verify_portal_access_shared.details: verify_portal_access checks both broker_id (owner) and portal_collaborators table for access

critical_code_review_comments: PropertyIntelligencePanel.js handleDelete (lines 456-494): Correctly uses fetch DELETE to backend API with auth token - bug fix verified
PortalDetail.js: Team Access tab properly implemented with collaborator list, invite dialog, and remove functionality
Portals.js: 'Shared' badge correctly shown for is_collaborator portals
portal_collaborators.py: Only portal owner can add/remove collaborators (_verify_portal_owner), but collaborators can view list (verify_portal_access)
portals.py list_portals: Correctly fetches both owned portals AND collaborator portals, marks shared ones with is_collaborator=True

test_credentials.note: CRM pages require Supabase auth - cannot test authenticated flows without credentials
